svg.title: Smaller work continues beneath the largest-run hold
svg.desc: Keep smaller work active beneath the largest-run hold. Relative scale and separate boundaries make continued activity compatible with a meaningful scoped pause. Visual distinction: A bounded workload tray with a large pause pair and a stop bar. A temporary operational disposition, not a breached wall or permanent destruction.
